Fix round 1 for US-01-02 is finished. The blocking finding B1 is fixed, and so are N3, N7, N10 and the content re-check. I made 4 commits on feature/US-01-02 and did not push. All gates pass. The whole acceptance suite ran on the new head 51d99c8 with a clean tree, on an Android API 32 emulator (the Medium_Phone AVD) that I started and then stopped myself.

Rows I reworded after the re-check (in 9bfaa40), and why:
- 3p-01: lemon instead of "ripe banana", because "ripe"/"dojrzały" is not a 3-year-old's word.
- 3p-20: "a lamp or a pillow?" with the answer "A lamp.", so torch or lamp no longer competes with "light".
- 3p-21: "What moves with you on the ground when the sun shines?", which drops the slightly spooky "dark shape".
- 3p-25: "pot of very hot water", which drops "boils".
- 3p-29: Polish is now "Co słodkiego robią pszczoły?", which drops "przysmak".
- 3p-34: English drops "horse-like".
- 3p-37: now the pig ("oink" / "chrum chrum"), so "Green" is no longer used twice.
- 3p-41: milk in the fridge ("W lodówce") instead of "zamrażarce".
- 3p-42: Polish no longer has the awkward "to".
- 3p-44: "the food we eat in the morning", which drops "meal"/"posiłek" and the circular wording.
- 3p-48: scarf around the neck, so gloves versus mittens no longer matters.

I left 3p-02 "Dwoje." as it is: "dwoje oczu" is the correct Polish for eyes.

The deck still has 50 questions. The longest question is 78 characters (en) and 77 (pl), the longest answer 20 (en) and 26 (pl). Each kind appears at least 12 times (13/12/13/12), and no question text repeats.
